description: Test fixture standing in for a judge registry (spec/court-record-key.md section 10.2) for the examples in examples/cap only. It is not a judge registry. It holds the judges who author a part of an example, each registered for the court code that example uses. examples/cap/build.py links a byline to a slug only when the text before the byline's first comma equals an entry's name after case folding (CAP prints HOOD and McDERMOTT, which match Hood and McDermott); no entry needs a printed form.
